title: The Maysville Road and Jackson’s veto, 1830
summary: The Maysville Road from the Ohio to Lexington drew Andrew Jackson’s 1830 veto of federal aid, yet Kentucky finished the turnpike in 1835 on today’s US 68.

items.text: Buffalo trace and settler road Maysville-Washington-Paris-Lexington; 1829 charter (marker: Maysville and Washington Turnpike Co., Jan 29 1829; Grokipedia: MWP&L Turnpike Road Co.).
Letcher bill, $150,000 stock; House 102-86 Apr 29 1830; Senate May 15; veto May 27 1830; Van Buren drafted.
First four miles done Nov 7 1830, earliest macadam west of Alleghenies; opened to Lexington 1835 with 13 tollhouses, 6 covered bridges.

timeline.event: House passes bill Apr 29; Senate May 15

openQuestions: Charter: marker names the Maysville and Washington Turnpike Company (Jan 29, 1829); Grokipedia names the MWP&L company; earlier research noted 1827 vs 1829.
